title: WaterColor 27 Red Cedar Way
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 12 wristbands.- Located just 400 feet from the new Camp Watercolor - Carriage house- Gas grill- Seasonal shuttle service - 4 adult bikes- 6- Passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Experience the allure of 27 Red Cedar Way, a cozy Eastern Cove cottage in WaterColor's highly sought-after Camp District. This 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom Main House and Carriage House has 2,700 square feet of living space and sleeps 12. Only 400 feet from Camp WaterColor and close to the beach club, enjoy access to 3 sparkling pools, a lazy river, and more. Guests will love the third-floor tower views, spacious wraparound porch, and quick stroll to private beach access!Situated on a spacious wooded corner lot, this elegant 3-story home, adorned in white and blue, has timeless coastal charm. Step inside to an open-concept layout with hardwood floors and coffered white walls, offering a welcoming space bathed in natural light. The kitchen is equipped with high-end stainless steel KitchenAid appliances. A light-filled dining alcove seats 8, with space for 4 more at the breakfast bar. In the thoughtfully designed living area, friends and family can sink into 2 comfortable slip-covered couches facing each other for endless conversation or relax in the matching swivel armchairs for clear views of the 46” TV. Cherish evenings on the wraparound porch as multiple generations dine alfresco seated at the table for 8, or sip iced tea from the comfort of plush furniture. Then, easily retire to the charming first-floor guest bedroom with a queen bed, TV, and private bathroom.Guests can unwind in the second-floor primary bedroom with a king bed and lovely guest bedroom features 2 twin beds—both with private bathrooms and TVs. The laundry room adds convenience.The third-floor tower features kid-friendly hideaway with seating for 2, a TV, and Blu-ray player surrounded by neighborhood views.The private Carriage House includes a kitchen, dining nook, living area with a queen sleeper sofa, and a guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom.27 Red Cedar Way blends WaterColor comfort and convenience, with on-site parking for 2 vehicles, 4 bikes, a low speed vehicle, and trolley service. Take Goldenrod Circle past WaterColor Inn for beach access. Book now!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 12):FIRST FLOOR: Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom With Tub/Shower ComboAdditional Sleeping Area: Queen Sleeper SofaSECOND FLOOR: Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Tub and ShowerGuest Bedroom: Two Twin Beds, Private Bathroom With Tub and Shower ComboCARRIAGE HOUSE: King Bed & Queen Sleeper, Private Bathroom with Tub/Shower ComboWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments, as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.Please note: Effective March 15, 2014, Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 80 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Only one cart may be rented per home, and rentals will be granted on a first-come, first-served basis.
